item.summary: fix(mattermost): require upload for local media on agent reply path (#125338) The monitor reply path sent local (non-http) media without requireMediaUpload, so a failed upload silently fell back to posting the caption alone while still reporting a successful media send. The file vanished with no visible error to the user. The message-tool send paths in channel.ts already require upload for non-http media; this aligns the reply path with that policy. Extract the shared requiresMattermostMediaUpload predicate into the lightweight normalize module (removing the duplicate in channel.ts) and apply it on the reply path so an upload failure surfaces instead of dropping the attachment. Co-authored-by: goffern
